Use case: sketch-to-render. Create one production candidate bitmap for a Star Trek virtual-tabletop room puzzle piece, Q03-R OFFICER SUITE in GALAXY CLASS materials.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED EXACT FLOOR PLAN. Preserve its overhead geometry, aspect, proportions, all walls, apertures, fixture footprints and spatial arrangement. Input image 2 supplies only the Galaxy material palette, not layout or camera.
Render one single directly overhead orthographic furnished suite, rectangular 20.25 m long x 7.5 m deep (2.7:1 footprint), aligned horizontally. Camera straight down, no perspective, no isometric projection. Ceiling removed. Thin wall tops like a professional realistic 3D-rendered battle map. Preserve generous floor circulation. Transparent outside the rectangular room; no board, border, text, labels, arrows or grid.
Exact topology from left to right: open dining/living/work area spanning 5.5 units; master bedroom x5.5 to8.5 y0 to3.4; PRIVATE walk-in closet x8.5 to10.5 y0 to3.4; head x10.5 to13.5 y0 to5. A private passage runs below bedroom and closet, y3.4 to5. Units 1.5m. Walls .1 units thick. Master bedroom must stay separate from closet with a wall and open sliding doorway at x8.5,y1.7. Closet bottom wall is SOLID: no passage entry. Hanging storage on closet's RIGHT wall. Bedroom entrance at x7.3,y3.4. Common-to-passage opening at x5.5,y4.2. Head opening at x10.5,y4.2. Main exterior entrance on bottom edge x2.7,y5. All five openings are clear, 1.2 units wide, with sills but NO moving door leaves.
Fixture positions follow guide exactly: recessed food replicator inside thick upper LEFT wall facing dining; dining table and two opposing chairs left; desk lower-left with chair BELOW facing desk; sofa top of living area and low table below it. Master double bed upper-left, wardrobe lower-left. Head: sonic shower upper-left, tub upper-right, basin left, toilet on right facing LEFT into open floor. No modern shower head. Three hull windows on top edge exactly where cyan marks occur.
Material style: warm taupe and ivory molded panels, soft rounded furniture, muted mauve carpet with restrained darker border, small dark wood accents, plum/slate upholstery, amber/lavender LCARS at desk and replicator. Warm neutral soft even lighting, subtle contact shadows. Bathroom pale non-slip floor, ivory fixtures. Render believable detailed fitted furniture, not colored diagram blocks. Keep shadows inside footprint and doors visibly open. No extra rooms, fixtures, windows or corridors; no people. This is a usable map master candidate, not a presentation board.
